_source.titles: Keys 1-200 are Plerdy's checklist titles in Plerdy's order. That order is load-bearing: plerdy_ref in checklist.json is this number, so an item can always be traced back to the numbered line it came from. Renumbering this file silently rewrites those references.
_source.not_here: The 17 items added by this plugin (GEO/AI search, llms.txt, AI-crawler policy, IndexNow, schema guards, lab Core Web Vitals, mobile layout) are not in the source and carry plerdy_ref: null. Their titles live in tools/build_checklist.py.
_source.keys: Non-numeric keys are metadata and are skipped by load_titles() in tools/build_checklist.py.
